children: Ollie's Bargain Outlet Holdings, Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $741.31M, net income of $85.45M and diluted EPS of $1.42, reflecting year-over-year growth driven largely by new store openings and improved gross margins.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per common share”.
Net sales rose 9.1% in the quarter and 11.5% year-to-date, driven primarily by new store openings.
Ollie's remains focused on brick-and-mortar retail with no online operations; growth is supported by opportunistic closeout buying and the "Good Stuff Cheap®" value proposition.
Opened 15 stores in the quarter and 42 YTD, bringing the total to 686 stores across 36 states as of Aug. 1, 2026.
Gross margin improvement was aided by lower supply-chain costs, including $29.4M in IEEPA tariff refunds.
